title: Will the US approve a $10B exchange stabilisation facility for Pakistan before 2027?
resolution_criteria: This question will resolve as **Yes** if, before January 1, 2027, [credible sources](https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/pakistan-eyes-bigger-china-swap-line-expects-us-financing-decision-soon-2026-09-17/) confirm that the U.S. government has formally approved an exchange stabilization support facility or equivalent currency swap of at least \$10 billion for Pakistan.
fine_print: A Yes resolution does not require the execution of the facility to happen within the question's time frame.
